category_title: Autistic students who correctly process problems with matching gestures
student_description: Awal is an autistic student who processes abstract geometric concepts by visually perceiving similarities between concrete, everyday objects. He relies heavily on explicit teacher gestures (like pointing) and tangible visual aids to guide his attention and bridge the gap between concrete items and abstract shapes.

criteria.rationale: Awal requires a consistent, long-term strategy of anchoring all new abstract geometric shapes to multiple real-world objects to build comprehension.
criteria.check: The long-term plan must explicitly state that new geometric concepts will be introduced by first presenting a variety of concrete, everyday objects that share that shape.

criteria.rationale: Awal needs to visually perceive similarities between physical objects and 2D images before he can successfully engage with a worksheet.
criteria.check: The long-term plan must include a routine of having the student visually compare concrete objects to the specific pictures on their upcoming task sheets before beginning the actual assignment.
